name: Angus mac Airt
text: Angus mac Airt was the son of Art mac Moma. He belonged to the Fianna of Fionn mac Conail. He often travelled in the company of Aed. One old title names him Angus of the terrible spear.

attributes.attribute: member of the Fianna, son of Art mac Moma

okr.objective: Record the warrior Angus mac Airt.
key_results: Name his father Art mac Moma.
